description: This file is a platform-specific script for firmware upgrading in the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to check and perform firmware upgrades based on board names.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that always returns success, indicating the firmware image check passes.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade by calling nand_do_upgrade or default_do_upgrade based on the detected board name.
